info.name: Flying Angels - Complete backend verification
info.description: All 39 controller endpoints plus positive/negative workflows. Run folders in order against a disposable database. Fixtures are relative to docs/postman. Development uses No Auth; for prod select collection Basic Auth and set username/password locally. CSRF headers are populated automatically when a token is returned.
